text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may return 1 non-Digi-Egg card with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in its text from your trash to the hand.
[Your Turn] When any of your other Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts are played, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Examon] in its text in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.

qa.question:
When a Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in its text is played, this card's [Your Turn] effect and that Digimon's [On Play] effect trigger simultaneously.
This card's [Your Turn] effect is activated first to digivolve this card.
At this time, in what order do I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect and the played card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer:
The [When Digivolving] effect is activated first.
When your Digimon was played, the [On Play] effect and the [Your Turn] effect triggered simultaneously.
Activating this card's [Your Turn] effect to digivolve the Digimon caused its [When Digivolving] effect to newly trigger, so it is activated first according to the derived triggering rule.

qa.question: What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
qa.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

qa.question: What kind of card does the text "[AA] or [BB] in its text" refer to?
qa.answer: It checks if that card has [AA] or [BB] in its text.
